name: Tatsuta Ui
source:
3rd year high school student.
A half-youkai, whose father is a dragon god. Her element is fire.
She's not very good at controlling herself so part of her powers are sealed.
Even though she is a high class youkai, she violated the prohibition and let [url=/c44598]Shinji[/url] live as a 'corpse'.
